card.name: Verbs reporting study findings
card.fires_on: Small words in results sentences of clinical-study text, right after the subject and before the reported finding or comparison, such as 'appeared to', 'were comparable', 'similar to', 'out of'.

modes.label: Linking verb or 'to'
